frontMatter.introduction:
At Rakheja Enterprises LLP, we are committed to responsible manufacturing built on safety, quality, integrity, and sustainability. As a garment manufacturing and export organization, our operations are guided by a strong focus on protecting people, conserving resources, maintaining ethical business practices, and safeguarding information.

This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Manual serves as the unified operational framework for Rakheja Enterprises LLP. It defines consistent practices across health and safety, environmental management, energy and water stewardship, governance, and information security. Through this integrated approach, we ensure that our day-to-day operations meet applicable legal requirements, buyer expectations, and recognized ESG standards.

This manual reflects our belief that disciplined processes, shared responsibility, and continuous improvement are essential to building resilient operations, delivering responsible products, and sustaining long-term value for our employees, customers, partners, and communities.
frontMatter.objective:
This SOP Manual has been developed to:
Establish standardized, consistent, and efficient operating procedures across all manufacturing, quality, compliance, and support functions.
Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws, health and safety regulations, environmental requirements, buyer codes of conduct, and export standards.
Improve productivity and operational efficiency while minimizing risks related to occupational health, safety, environmental impact, and product quality.
Promote responsible use of energy, water, materials, and other resources across all operations.
Foster a workplace culture founded on integrity, accountability, ethical conduct, and continuous improvement.
Enable employees and contract workers to perform their duties confidently, safely, and in alignment with company standards and customer expectations.
frontMatter.scope:
This SOP Manual applies to all our manufacturing facilities and encompasses all employees, stakeholders, partners, contractors, customers, suppliers, and any other individuals or entities acting on behalf of Rakheja Enterprises LLP.

This SOP encompasses processes and procedures across health and safety management, emergency preparedness, equipment safety, contractor and non-employee safety, employee support initiatives, energy and climate management, water stewardship, environmental resource efficiency, and other related operational and compliance areas.

blocks.text: To establish a structured process for managing confidential data breaches, minimizing impact, and ensuring timely reporting and resolution in compliance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.
This SOP applies to all employees, departments, and business units handling confidential or sensitive data, including internal, third-party, and stakeholder information.

body.text:
Incident Identification: Promptly identify any suspected or actual breach of confidential data.
Immediate Reporting: Report the incident to the IT/Security Team and Compliance Team as soon as it is detected.

Initial Assessment: Evaluate the scope, severity, and potential impact of the breach.
Containment Measures: Take immediate action to contain the breach, including restricting system access, isolating affected devices, or suspending compromised accounts.

Root Cause Analysis: Determine the cause of the breach and affected data categories.
Impact Assessment: Identify affected stakeholders, systems, and potential regulatory obligations.

Internal Communication: Inform senior management, legal, and compliance teams.
External Notification: Notify affected stakeholders and regulatory authorities as required by law or policy.

Corrective Actions: Implement measures to prevent recurrence, such as system patches, process changes, or employee retraining.
Data Restoration: Restore affected data from backups where possible and verify integrity.
Maintain a complete record of the incident, actions taken, lessons learned, and recommendations for process improvements.

responsibilities: Detect, contain, and remediate breaches; implement technical measures.
Ensure regulatory compliance and manage stakeholder notifications.
Support incident investigation and enforce corrective actions.
Report suspected breaches immediately and cooperate with investigations.

blocks.text: To ensure that organizational records are retained securely for the required period and disposed of safely, in compliance with regulatory, legal, and internal requirements.
This SOP applies to all employees, departments, and business units responsible for creating, handling, storing, and disposing of company records, including physical and digital formats.

body.text:
Classification: Identify types of records and categorize them according to retention requirements (e.g., financial, HR, compliance, operational).
Retention Periods: Retain records for the duration mandated by regulatory requirements or internal policies, whichever is longer.
Secure Storage: Store physical records in locked cabinets and digital records in secure, access-controlled systems.

Authorized Disposal: Dispose of records only after the retention period has expired and in accordance with internal approval procedures.
Secure Methods:
Physical records: Shredding or incineration.
Digital records: Secure deletion, wiping, or destruction of media.
Documentation: Maintain logs of disposed records, including type, date, method of disposal, and approving authority.

Conduct periodic audits to ensure adherence to retention and disposal schedules.
Update retention schedules in line with changes in legal, regulatory, or organizational requirements.

responsibilities: Ensure their teams follow retention and disposal procedures.

blocks.text: To ensure that all third-party engagements, sensitive transactions, and data-handling partnerships are conducted with integrity, compliance, and minimal risk exposure to Rakheja Enterprises LLP. This SOP provides a structured approach for anti-corruption, approvals, and information security due diligence.

This SOP applies to all employees involved in engaging vendors, partners, or service providers, and to all business units processing sensitive transactions or sharing organizational data with third parties.

steps.heading: 3.1 Anti-Corruption Due Diligence on Third Parties

substeps.text: Screening of Vendors and Partners: Conduct background checks on all potential vendors and partners for anti-corruption compliance, legal history, and reputation.
Evaluation: Assess third-party risk based on business nature, transaction value, geographic location, and regulatory exposure.
Documentation: Maintain records of due diligence assessments, approvals, and risk ratings.
Defined Authorization Controls: Identify transaction types that require higher-level approvals (e.g., large payments, high-risk contracts).
Escalation Protocols: Establish a clear escalation path to ensure that sensitive transactions are reviewed and authorized by designated personnel.
Record-Keeping: Document approvals, justifications, and related correspondence for audit and compliance purposes.

steps.heading: 3.3 Information Security Due Diligence on Third Parties

substeps.text: Risk Assessment: Evaluate third-party data-handling practices to ensure compliance with organizational information security policies and applicable laws.
Data Protection Measures: Verify security controls, encryption, access management, and incident response capabilities of third-party partners.
Ongoing Monitoring: Periodically review third-party compliance and address gaps through remediation plans or contractual updates.

responsibilities: Initiate due diligence and provide required documentation for approvals.
Conduct anti-corruption checks, review sensitive transaction approvals, and oversee third-party risk assessment.
Assess information security practices of third-party partners and provide recommendations.
Follow SOPs when engaging with vendors, approving transactions, or sharing data externally.

blocks.text: To ensure the protection of third-party data and compliance with privacy regulations by implementing proper controls for access, disclosure, and consent management. This SOP establishes processes to safeguard sensitive information and respect the rights of stakeholders.
This SOP applies to all employees, departments, and business units handling third-party data, including vendors, partners, customers, and other external stakeholders.

body.text:
Access Controls: Implement role-based access to ensure only authorized personnel can view or process third-party data.
Data Security Measures: Use encryption, secure storage, and network protections to prevent unauthorized access or data breaches.
Monitoring & Audit: Regularly monitor data access logs and conduct audits to detect and respond to unauthorized activities.
Incident Management: Follow defined procedures for reporting and addressing data breaches or unauthorized disclosures.

Consent Collection: Obtain explicit consent from stakeholders for processing, sharing, or retaining their personal data.
Documentation: Maintain accurate records of consents, including date, scope, and purpose of data usage.
Consent Updates: Regularly review and update consent records to ensure they remain valid and compliant with applicable laws.
Withdrawal of Consent: Provide stakeholders with a clear process to withdraw consent and ensure data handling practices are updated accordingly.

responsibilities: Oversee consent management, data protection measures, and regulatory compliance.
Implement technical controls for data protection and monitor access.
Handle third-party data responsibly, follow access controls, and report any incidents immediately.

blocks.text: This SOP Manual will be reviewed annually to ensure its effectiveness, relevance, and compliance with applicable regulations and organizational requirements. Feedback from safety inspections, audits, operational experience, and stakeholder inputs will be considered during the review process. Necessary updates will be incorporated to improve procedures. All revisions will be documented and communicated to ensure continuous improvement and effective implementation.
